description: Paid endpoint ($0.002): USDT and USDC circulating supply in total and per chain, with 24h and 7d change in USD and %, from DefiLlama (refreshed ~hourly). Chains under min_chain_usd (default $10M) roll into an other row. Per-chain changes include bridging, not only mints and burns. Optional: assets (USDT, USDC), min_chain_usd. Bad params 400, stale data (>3h) 503; no charge on errors. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/stablecoin-flows

min_chain_usd.description: Chains below this USD supply roll into other (default 10000000)

name: get_stablecoin_flows
title: Stablecoin supply flows (paid, x402) — $0.002

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
